name: spiritual-content-app
description: A modern web application for spiritual content

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: rm -rf backend/public && mkdir -p backend/public && cp -R frontend/build/* backend/public/ && cd backend && npm ci && npx prisma generate && npm run build
scripts.railway:start: cd backend && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate deploy && npm start
scripts.db:setup: cd backend && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
